segments.en: So tell me a little bit about where this philosophy came from.
segments.zh: 所以告诉我一些关于这种哲学的来源。

segments.en: What are the origins of this idea?
segments.zh: 这个想法的起源是什么？

segments.en: It actually became really popular with Toyota, and it was called the Toyota Production System.
segments.zh: 它实际上在丰田中真正流行起来，它被称为丰田生产系统。

segments.en: So many people think it's Japanese, but in reality, the Japanese got it from the United States.
segments.zh: 很多人认为是日本人，但实际上，日本人是从美国得到的。

segments.en: It's a philosophy that was thought up by Ford Motor Company in order to improve their production line.
segments.zh: 这是福特汽车公司为改善生产线而设想的理念。

segments.en: But when the Japanese visited Ford Motor Company, it wasn't fully implemented yet, and oddly enough, they found this philosophy working already in a piggly-wiggly.
segments.zh: 但是当日本人访问福特汽车公司时，它还没有完全实施，奇怪的是，他们发现这种理念已经在麻烦中起作用了。

segments.en: What's a piggly-wiggly?
segments.zh: 什么是小猪摇摆？

segments.en: Piggly-wiggly was a chain of grocery stores in the United States.
segments.zh: Piggly-Wiggly 是美国的一家杂货店连锁店。

segments.en: I'm not sure if they're still around, but yeah, they were really big, and basically piggly-wiggly was using this to improve their whole system of shipping and of stocking and everything.
segments.zh: 我不确定它们是否还在身边，但是，它们真的很大，基本上 Piggly-Wiggly 正在使用它来改善他们的整个运输和放养系统和所有东西。

segments.en: Okay, so how does it work?
segments.zh: 好的，那它是如何工作的呢？

segments.en: So basically what you try to do is make your processes more efficient, reduce the amount of space you're using, et cetera.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你试图做的是让你的流程更高效，减少你使用的空间量等等。

segments.en: And this was really important for Japanese because, of course, they don't have that much space in Japan to have these huge warehouses like in other countries.
segments.zh: 这对日本人来说真的很重要，因为当然，他们在日本没有那么多空间可以像其他国家一样拥有这些巨大的仓库。

segments.en: So what you're saying is they're producing goods just for the time they need it, right?
segments.zh: 所以你的意思是他们只是为了他们需要的时间生产商品，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So trying to not be overstocked or- Or have a long lead time or something.
segments.zh: 所以尽量不要库存过多，或者有很长的交货时间或其他东西。

segments.en: Long lead times where you have to keep something in a warehouse, exactly.
segments.zh: 很长的交货时间，您必须将东西放在仓库中，确切地说。

segments.en: So that's why it's so efficient.
segments.zh: 所以这就是它如此高效的原因。

segments.en: And also it's about improving the efficiency between processes.
segments.zh: 而且它是关于提高流程之间的效率。

segments.en: So what's sometimes called a bottleneck.
segments.zh: 所以有时被称为瓶颈。

segments.en: You can have really good processes in the beginning, but in the end, maybe you have only one workstation that's taking all these orders and everything gets bottled up and it causes delays.
segments.zh: 一开始你可以有非常好的流程，但最终，也许你只有一个工作站接受所有这些订单，一切都被封存起来，这会导致延误。

segments.en: It's slow, yeah.
segments.zh: 它很慢，是的。

segments.en: So in the dialogue, they want to implement the just-in-time strategy as a way of avoiding redundancies.
segments.zh: 因此，在对话中，他们希望实施即时战略作为避免冗余的一种方式。

segments.en: But it sounds to me like actually this might cause redundancies sometimes.
segments.zh: 但在我看来，这实际上有时可能会导致冗余。

segments.en: Well, yeah, sometimes it does.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，有时确实如此。

segments.en: Sometimes when you make workstations more efficient or when you make all your processes work more fluidly, sometimes inevitably you will have to lay off some people that are redundant.
segments.zh: 有时，当您使工作站更有效率或使您的所有流程更流畅时，有时您将不得不解雇一些多余的人。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Have you ever worked in a company where they've implemented just-in-time?
segments.zh: 你有没有在他们及时实施的公司工作过？

segments.en: No, actually, I've never really worked at a place where this philosophy was working, but I did used to work at a place where we had Six Sigma, which is a little bit similar.
segments.zh: 不，实际上，我从来没有真正在这种哲学发挥作用的地方工作过，但我确实曾经在我们有六西格码的地方工作，这有点相似。

segments.en: Well, I guess we'll need a lesson on Six Sigma in the future.
segments.zh: 好吧，我想我们将来需要一堂关于六西格码的课程。

segments.en: Yeah, we'll see if we come up with Six Sigma and what it means.
segments.zh: 是的，我们会看看我们是否想出了六西格码以及这意味着什么。

segments.en: It's kind of interesting, but we want to hear what you think.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，但我们想听听你的想法。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Have you guys worked in a place where they use just-in-time?
segments.zh: 你们有没有在他们及时使用的地方工作过？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Or if you have any quality control measures or how does your company avoid having defective items or defective services?
segments.zh: 或者，如果您有任何质量控制措施，或者您的公司如何避免有缺陷的物品或有缺陷的服务？

segments.en: So visit our website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: And Marco and I are always around to respond to your comments and answer your questions.
segments.zh: Marco 和我总是在身边回复您的评论并回答您的问题。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So until then, it's-
segments.zh: 所以在那之前，它是——

segments.en: Goodbye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
